newsitem.title: ITALY: Italcementi 1996 group profit, sales slip.
newsitem.headline: Italcementi 1996 group profit, sales slip.

text.p: Italy's Italcementi group, the largest cement producer in the European Union, said it posted 1996 consolidated profit of 87 billion lire against a previous 111 billion on sales of 5.142 trillion lire against 5.469 trillion.

The group said in a statement that the parent company made a profit of 41 billion lire against a 1995 loss of 3.3 billion lire, which allowed the company to pay a gross ordinary dividend of 100 lire versus 80.
Italcementi said that, in the first months of 1997, the group had seen a "significant recovery in operating profit" and was positive about the full year results.
The group announced in February that 1996 parent company operating profit was around 62 billion lire against 52 billion in the previous year.
